title: Can Language Models Get "Aphasia" From Neuronal Ablation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Progressive neuronal loss is the hallmark of neurodegenerative disease, yet how loss of neurons shapes the pattern of cognitive decline remains poorly understood. Here we systematically ablate neurons (computational units) in language models spanning recurrent long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer architectures and apply limited fine-tuning as a simple proxy for compensatory plasticity. With whole-unit ablation, LSTMs degrade gradually with syntactic and semantic faculties declining in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. By contrast, Transformers exhibit late threshold-like collapse under feedforward multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ablation and smoother sigmoid-like decline under attention-head ablation. Qualitatively, MLP-ablated models continue to make within-category semantic substitutions (semantic paraphasias) alongside rising non-responses, paralleling Wernicke-type aphasia, while attention-head ablation produces a trend

translated_title: 语言模型会因神经元消融而患上“失语症”吗？
translated_abstract: 渐进性神经元丢失是神经退行性疾病的标志，然而神经元丢失如何塑造认知衰退的模式仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们系统性地消融了涵盖循环长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和Transformer架构的语言模型中的神经元（计算单元），并采用有限的微调作为代偿性可塑性的简单代理。在全单元消融下，LSTM在轻度至中度损伤范围内呈渐进式退化，其语法和语义能力平行下降。相比之下，Transformer在前馈多层感知机（MLP）消融下表现出晚期的阈值式崩溃，而在注意力头消融下则呈现更平滑的S型下降。在定性层面，MLP消融后的模型仍会做出类别内的语义替换（语义错语症），同时非响应率上升，这与Wernicke型失语症相似，而注意力头消融则产生了一种趋势……
tldr: 该研究通过系统性消融语言模型神经元发现，LSTM呈渐进式退化，而Transformer在MLP消融下出现类似Wernicke型失语症的阈值式崩溃，表明语言模型可作为研究神经退行性疾病认知衰退模式的计算代理。
en_tdlr: This study systematically ablates neurons in language models and finds that LSTMs degrade gradually while Transformers exhibit threshold-like collapse under MLP ablation resembling Wernicke-type aphasia, suggesting language models can serve as computational proxies for studying cognitive decline in neurodegenerative diseases.
